question: Should `createChannelIngressMonitor` become the canonical durable-ingress lifecycle contract for these six bundled channels after adapter-specific replay and shutdown proof is reviewed?
rationale: The branch intentionally centralizes behavior that previously remained channel-owned, so maintainers must confirm that the shared lifecycle options preserve the operational contracts of all affected transports.

options.title: Review and land with runtime proof
options.body: Confirm each adapter's replay, acknowledgement, and bounded-stop contract and add redacted after-fix runtime evidence before merging.

options.title: Narrow the refactor
options.body: Land only adapters whose lifecycle contract is already proven equivalent, leaving exceptional channels on their local implementation temporarily.

options.title: Pause shared API expansion
options.body: Keep the channel-local implementations until maintainers define and document the stable shared monitor contract.

recommendation.title: Review and land with runtime proof
recommendation.body: Confirm each adapter's replay, acknowledgement, and bounded-stop contract and add redacted after-fix runtime evidence before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit sequence shows ownership of the cross-channel refactor and its adapter contracts.
